description: deep-mode containment guard: once a /deep-mode: command runs in a session, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit outside the project root are denied

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/deep-mode/assets/contain/claude_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$f" activate "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"; fi; exec python3 "$f" activate "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"

f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/deep-mode/assets/contain/claude_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$f" if-active "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"; fi; exec python3 "$f" if-active "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"

f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/deep-mode/assets/contain/claude_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$f" end "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"; fi; exec python3 "$f" end "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}"
